Oil Prices Fluctuate, Impacting Dollar and US Interest Rate Expectations

Global oil prices experienced fluctuations, with one report indicating a rally that sent the dollar higher due to expectations of increased US interest rates. Conversely, another report stated that the dollar slipped as oil prices sank, while bond yields stabilized. These movements in oil prices are linked to anticipated shifts in US monetary policy.
